text.p: Great Portland Estates Plc said it bought private property company Ilex Ltd for a total sum of 58.6 million stg.
The acquisition will be marginally dilutive in the short term, while being neutral for the year ending March 1999, Great Portland said.

The two main properties in Ilex's portfolio are two long leaseholds in London's Bond Street. Ilex also has an 11.3 percent beneficial interest in the Pollen Estate, which owns 45 freeholds in London's West End.
Ilex's annual rental income is 3.46 million stg, but Great Portland said this should rise to 4.2 million within 15 months. The expected rise is due the settlement of outstanding rent reviews.
Ilex director and shareholder Alastair MacDonald will join Great Portland's board as a non-executive director from August 11.
Great Portland will finance the Ilex acquisition in the form of unsecured loan notes worth 17 million stg, while paying the remaining 41.6 million stg in cash.
